upstream_license: Official original TUM licence terms not independently retrieved; previously403throughconfiguredproxy. Public mirror provides pinned provenance only, no new redistributiongrant.
physical_relative_pose_ground_truth: Original pinned TUM motion-capture camera poses; full numeric source previously evaluated in PR11. This acquisition checks timestamp columns and row arity only and does not parse numeric pose columns. Operational fits must not consume reference poses.
ground_truth_format: timestamp tx ty tz qx qy qz qw; world-from-camera; metres; xyzw quaternion

depth_calibration.frame: registered optical camera x-right y-down z-forward
depth_calibration.limitations: Published FR1 RGB source-model research calibration, not independently measured in this environment. Pinhole image projection without Brown-Conrady correction is an approximation; native infrared extrinsics, source depth registration and vehicle calibration are not independently validated. No additional range correction is applied.

selection_policy: Fixed original depth indices 100–279, declared before extension metadata or image acquisition. Partly viewed temporal extension of the same FR1 room source: indices 100–135 were viewed in PR11; indices 136–279 image acquisitions were previously unviewed. Full numeric GT was viewed in PR11, but this preparation parses only timestamp columns and row arity. No candidate/window search, image inspection, feature fitting, accuracy selection or recalibration. All estimator defaults and gates remain unchanged. Initial100 initializes; 101–135 viewed_prefix; 136–279 unviewed_extension. All 179 updates and seven repeated RGB associations remain selected. Missing original images acquired opaquely only after immutable source/window journal; hashes and original Git blob identity verified without signatures/headers/dimensions/pixels. Root-owned final algorithm/checker freeze precedes first continuous extended run. Not a fresh environment or independent generalization trial.
